info.title: Signicat Sign API v2
info.description:
- **Base URL**: `https://api.signicat.com/sign/`
- **Documentation**: See the [Sign API v2](/docs/electronic-signing/sign-api-v2/) developer documentation.
- **Support**: [Create a support ticket](https://dashboard.signicat.com/contact-us/tickets/) in the Signicat Dashboard.

# Introduction

The Signicat Sign API v2 is a REST API using European identity providers for creating electronic signatures on contracts, declarations, forms and other documents.

This REST API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authorisation. All request and response bodies are formatted in JSON.

# Get started

Before you can start making requests to this API, you need to learn how to connect to it. To do this, see the **Connect to Signicat APIs** [Quick start guide](/docs/dashboard/connect-to-signicat-apis/quick-start-guide/).

## Audit logs

Use the Signicat **Audit logs** service to see documented evidence of the sequence of activities that have affected a system.

- Access it: **Signicat Dashboard** > **Settings** > [**Audit logs**](https://dashboard.signicat.com/audit)
- For information generic to all Signicat audit logs, see the general [Audit logs](/docs/dashboard/settings/audit-logs/) documentation.

## Errors

When you make an API call to Signicat and an error occurs, you will receive a response message with an error code.

- For errors generic to all Signicat APIs, see the general [Error codes](/docs/dashboard/error-codes/) documentation.
- For errors specific to this service, see the Sign API v2 [Error codes](/docs/electronic-signing/sign-api-v2/error-codes/) documentation.

## Events (callback)

Use the Signicat **Events** service to automatically receive information about when something happens in one of our services into your system.

- Access it: Go to **Signicat Dashboard** > **Settings** > [**Events**](https://dashboard.signicat.com/events)
- For information generic to all Signicat events, see the general [Events](/docs/dashboard/settings/events/) documentation.

> **Note**: This is often referred to as callback.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of signing sessions
get.description: Returns a paginated list of signing sessions, with optional controls for `offset`, `limit` and `sort`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting field. Default value is -createdAt. E.g., +dueDate

parameters.name: createdDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter signing sessions created on or after this date and time

parameters.name: createdDateTo
parameters.description: Filter signing sessions created on or before this date and time

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Search field for state. Multiple values allowed. E.g., BLOCKED, READY. See also SessionState enum for possible values.

parameters.name: dueDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter signing sessions with due date on or after this date and time

parameters.name: dueDateTo
parameters.description: Filter signing sessions with due date on or before this date and time

parameters.name: sessionTitleLike
parameters.description: Filter signing sessions by title using partial text matching (case-insensitive)

post.description: Enables business to business (B2B) signing with a merchant certificate from a specified vendor.

bearerAuth.description: Access token for protecting the API.

filename.description: A name to use if the document is to be stored as a file. Optional metadata about the stored document which the customer can supply.

description.description: A description of the document for display purposes. Optional metadata about the stored document which the customer can supply.

title.description: A title of the document for display purposes. Optional metadata about the stored document which the customer can supply.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the uploaded document. Supported types are text/plain, text/markdown and application/pdf.

documentId.description: The unique ID of the uploaded document.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the document was uploaded.

documentHash.description: The calculated hash of the document. This contains the following two items.

id.description: The unique ID of the document collection.

packageTo.description: A list of formats the collection should be packaged to when all sessions connected to it are signed.

serialSigning.description: Whether to enable serial signing for the document collection.

documentId.description: The unique ID of the uploaded document.

signatureUrlTTL.description: Deprecated! Use signatureUrlTimeToLive instead. Time-to-live for the signature URL in minutes

signatureUrlTimeToLive.description: Time-to-live for the signature URL. Must be an ISO 8601 duration and a maximum of 45 days.

title.description: A title for the signing session.

signText.description: Text displayed when starting the signing process. The signer must explicitly consent to this text before signing.

dueDate.description: The deadline for signing the document(s). Optional; if omitted, defaults to 30 days after session creation. You can explicitly set a deadline up to 45 days into the future.

externalReference.description: Custom identifier for linking the signing session to your internal process. Passed back in redirect URLs.

signingSetup.description: The user interaction setups for this signing session describing which IDPs are available for the end-user.

subsequentTo.description: IDs of signing sessions that must be signed before this one.

packageTo.description: A list of formats the signing session should be packaged to when signed.

sealTo.description: A list of formats the signing session should be sealed to when signed.

signer.description: The intended signer of the signing Session.

archive.description: Defines what objects should be added to archive. To use this functionality you must contact Signicat Support.

preAuthentication.description: Sets up authentication of the signer before presenting documents.

ui.description: Defines UI settings for the signing session.

intentionText.description: A text indicating the end-user's intention when signing a document. Applicable when using flow PKISIGNING

usageTags.description: A list of tags to emit with events for the sign sessions

language.description: Specifies the language to be used in the signing UI.

hideWelcomeScreen.description: Hides the welcome dialog in the signing UI

minimalTextMode.description: Enables a minimal UI mode for a single and short text/plain document

value.description: Intention text value to display in the UI

format.description: Format of the intention text to display in the UI

documentCollectionId.description: The unique ID of the document collection this document belongs to.

action.description: The action the signer is meant to perform on this document.

documentId.description: The unique ID of the uploaded document.

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail
ProblemDetail.description: The common error object. Adheres to RFC7807

type.description: An RFC3986 URI reference to the documentation that identifies the problem

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem

code.description: A short machine-readable string indicating the error code

invalidParams.description: Used when handling validation errors. Can report multiple errors in the same call

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem

InvalidParamDetail.description: Contains information about how validation failed for a parameter

name.description: The name of the parameter that failed validation

reason.description: The reason why the validation failed

SigningSetup.description: What IdPs are available to the end-user and what type of signing flow should take place.

identityProviders.description: The list of identity providers (IdPs) available for the end-user to choose from. If not specified, all configured IdPs on the account will be shown as options.

signingFlow.description: The type of signing flow to be  performed. `AUTHENTICATION_BASED` is a simple flow which  uses authentication evidence as input for displaying information in the PAdES/XAdES.

additionalParameters.description: Additional parameters that modify the authentication flow. Depends on selected IdP. See developer documentation for details.

requestedAttributes.description: Requested Attributes from IDP (name and idp attributes are default)

sendSealingResultToArchive.description: Whether generated sealing results should be sent to Archive.

retentionPeriod.description: How long the archived documents should be stored, in ISO 8601 duration format. Maximum 50 years.

archiveTags.description: A list of tags to associate with the archived document.

identityProviders.description: The identity providers offered to the signer during pre-authentication.

parentSessionId.description: The ID of the session that was forwarded to create this session

childSessionIds.description: List of child session IDs created by forwarding this session

senderAddress.description: The email address that the person forwarded to receives email notifications from.

count.description: Number of items in current page

UserInfo.description: The subject attributes of the signer, as described by the IdP.

language.description: Specifies the language to be used in the notification

text.example: A signing session has been created and is ready for your signature.

SerialSigningOutput.description: Contains metadata of a completed serial signing.

originalDocumentId.description: The unique ID of the original document that was signed.

archiveResultId.description: The unique ID of the archived result document.

resultDocumentId.description: The unique ID of the signed document stored in Docstore.

numberOfSignatures.description: The number of signatures added to the document.
